design.title: Enhanced Custom Role Prompts (自定义角色提示词增强)
design.summary: Enhance the existing agent prompt editing experience on both dashboard and CLI. Add: (1) prompt templates registry with 7 built-in role templates, (2) fullscreen prompt editor overlay in dashboard, (3) template picker dropdown, (4) prompt preview showing composed prompt with skills/team context, (5) character count, (6) CLI $EDITOR support for interactive editing, (7) `agents prompt` shortcut subcommand, (8) `agents preview` subcommand, (9) `--template` flag for create/edit.

newExports.PROMPT_TEMPLATES: Record<string, { description: string; prompt: string }> — 7 built-in role templates
newExports.composePromptPreview(): Composes full agent prompt (base + skills + team context)

newApiEndpoints.GET /api/agents/preview?name=X: Returns composed prompt preview for an agent

newCliCommands.agents preview <name>: Show full composed prompt with section breakdown
newCliCommands.--template <name>: Flag for create/edit to pre-populate from template

dashboardUiChanges: Expand button (⛶) next to System Prompt label

wave_1: task_1: PROMPT_TEMPLATES + getPromptTemplates + composePromptPreview in agents.ts
task_2: Fullscreen editor + char count in dashboard.html
wave_3: task_6: Wire dashboard template picker + preview to API

keyDecisions.templates_as_constants: Hardcoded in agents.ts, not files — simpler, version-controlled
keyDecisions.fullscreen_as_overlay: Fixed overlay, not new page — preserves SPA architecture
keyDecisions.preview_shows_all_sections: Base + skills + team context for debugging
keyDecisions.templates_only_set_prompt: Templates don't set tools/model/skills — orthogonal concerns
keyDecisions.bidirectional_textarea_sync: Modal textarea ↔ fullscreen textarea stay in sync
